selection: Explicit frozen source batches. The initial 18-report selection excluded then-running authority reports; subsequent batches are listed under collections and additional_batch_scope. Installed-wheel reports remain excluded.

transformations.key_redaction: Only complete nxs_ tokens with 48 lowercase hexadecimal characters accepted by domain.keys.is_well_formed_api_key. No other text is redacted.
transformations.line_endings: CRLF and CR normalized to LF before artifact hashing; full parsed XML after approved key redaction must remain identical.
transformations.whitespace: Trailing spaces/tabs encoded as numeric XML character entities, preserving parsed text, attributes and tails.
transformations.provenance: Original SHA256 and absolute source path are retained separately from normalized artifact SHA256. These are report hashes, not claims about the Python source loaded by a test process.

limitations: The 67-case core-source-initial run loaded an older storage test version while root edited that source during execution. Traceback rendering can therefore show newer source lines. No fixture/source-content hash is claimed for that process.

The core initial report is preserved including all four failures, but excluded from consolidated final coverage. The nine-case bounds/storage report supersedes storage evidence, and the 48-case operations refactor report covers the retained operations tests. Six former authority test identities were transferred/reworked in the independently running authority family and are historical-only in this frozen selection; the older unparameterized upgrade identity is superseded by parameterized 160/161 upgrade cases.

Distinct coverage is aggregated across eligible source reports using testcase classname/name and latest suite-start timestamp. Repeated executions are not added. This is not a claim that all cases were executed together against one frozen source hash.
Automatic runtime and MCP integration tests use synthetic peers. They prove canonical Server integration, not qualification of a real provider client.

The handoff-navigation-source-initial report loaded domain.occurrence before executor_id was added. Its 15 transient failures are retained; the affected cases passed after the shared signature was frozen in handoff-navigation-source-final. No immutable source hash is claimed for that initial process.

Authority review-fixes similarly ran before domain.occurrence accepted executor_id; its five transient failures remain historical evidence and were followed by final affected-case runs. Earlier authority failures/errors were fixture integration defects (missing opening receipt, stale lane ticket after endpoint change, invalid uppercase INLINE enum), retained without reclassifying their original XML outcomes.

The passing test_global_feature_toggle_has_no_persisted_episode_generation documents that global feature off/on/off reuses the attention episode because no persisted flag generation exists. It is observation of a known limitation, not acceptance evidence for AT-08 episode recurrence.

final_coverage_excluded_artifacts.plans/agent_ops/evidence/pr06-attention-: Historical initial run with source-edited-during-execution limitation; retain counts/failures, use independent corrections for final coverage.

coverage.method: Distinct (classname,name); latest eligible suite start timestamp wins. Repeated executions are never added as coverage.
